study type: Experimental animal study (and in vitro characterization)
outcome: Expression level of PXR and its downstream proteins
cohort: The study participants were kainic acid (KA)-induced mice models of epilepsy.
finding: NPs/KCZ achieved epileptic foci-targeted delivery of KCZ and ameliorated the efficacy of CBZ on drug-resistant epilepsy by attenuating the overactivity of PXR in mice.
